info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official AWSKendraFrontendService API (2019-02-03). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. Indexes are stored ACTIVE configuration with no capacity units and zero indexed documents and FAQs: nothing is provisioned, indexed, searched or billed, and the role, KMS key, token configurations and IAM Identity Center settings are stored without being used. Index metadata field configurations are not reported and DocumentMetadataConfigurationUpdates and CapacityUnits updates are refused. Data sources are stored ACTIVE connector configuration: no repository, website, database or SaaS application is crawled, the schedule never runs and no enrichment Lambda function is invoked. CUSTOM data sources take no Configuration, RoleArn or Schedule; every other type needs Configuration and RoleArn. Deleting an index also deletes its data sources. Query, Retrieve, document and FAQ ingestion, data source sync jobs, thesauri, query suggestions, featured results, access control configurations, principal mappings, experiences and feedback return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501.
